opportunities.title: Regular Grant

amount.raw: Regular Grant – under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects no greater than £30,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Not available to individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities, supporting charities across the UK. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant

amount.raw: £100,000 and over. For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital or project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For core costs, annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital or project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply for a regular grant instead.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via an Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis.
